reviews.title: Works great
reviews.comment: Love, the key board has slim overall design. I'm able to rest my palms on the desk while typing being able to reach all the keys.
reviews.author: Amazon Customer

reviews.title: Perfect for me
reviews.comment:
i love this keyboard and I type on it for work every day. I've always wanted a Keychron keyboard, but I could never get one at a good time. Also, the version that I always wanted is no longer sold. So I went with this one. I'm still getting used to the somewhat fullsize of the keyboard and the keys are pretty close together so it feels weird. I've been typing on a low profile keyboard with smaller keys and more space between them so I tend to hit the wrong key more often. Again I'm getting used to the new keyboard and I hope to buy another one that will replace the low profile keyboard that I use at home.
Product wise, it's sturdy and has some heft so it doesn't move around much at all. So the weight is perfect. I chose keys that tend to be more quiet so clickiness wasn't something I cared for. Sound quality is good for the rotary volume knob and I like that I can just press it to mute and unmute sound. Bluetooth connectivity as well as the dongle and wired options are nice and the battery life of the keyboard is really good. I use it for around 12 hours a day and I work 5-6 days a week so I charge it once a week.
reviews.author: Mellysia

reviews.title: Great low profile keyboard.
reviews.comment: I only returned the keyboard because I order the wrong version.  Keychron's downside is that there are to many variations.  If you do not like climbing up on a wrist rest to type, then you should consider the K17 or K5.  Minimalistic looking and limited key caps for sure, but aftermarket key caps can fix the looks.
reviews.author: BRADLEY ALBERS

reviews.title: Great keyboard
reviews.comment: It's a great keyboard. Really high quality.  I put off buying a low profile mechanical keyboard for a kooong time but this quickly became my favorite keyboard.
reviews.author: Robert De Luca

reviews.title: broken product and terrible customer service
reviews.comment: No matter what method I used to try to connect (bluetooth, wireless dongle, and wired) or what computer i used (2 different macbook pros and pc desktop), I could not get this keyboard to connect and stay connected. Even when it did connect for a few minutes, it would type the wrong letters or type multiple copies of the same letter or spaces. It is clearly broken. I contacted customer service, sending the receipt. They then wanted proof of delivery. I sent that. Then they wanted me to take videos of all of the scenarios. I have a crazy busy job, kids, school, and can barely keep up with every day life, especially at the end of the school year. I do not have time to be taking a bunch of videos of it not working...remember, it's three different computers and three different ways of connecting... and sending all of those and then keep following up with customer service who took over 2 days to get back to me each time. I finally have a minute to deal with this, and now it's too late. I would understand if I had tried returning things in the past, but this is my first time buying Keychron products. And definitely my last. Not sure what i'm going to do with this broken keyboard. Bought a Nuphy instead and it is a million times better. Go get a Nuphy instead.
reviews.author: lst
